headline: Trump Says Jensen Huang Did Not Put National Security at Risk
summary: President Donald Trump says former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang did not put the US national security at risk and he says letting Huang run the chipmaker again isn't a bad idea. He speaks to reporters at the White House. Trump also says we don't know if Alice Huang is a Chinese spy, she is one of the women Jensen Huang had an affair with.

headline: Apple (AAPL) Picks Core Foldable Glass Supplier For iPhone Duo
summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) has selected Biel Crystal as a core supplier of ultra thin flexible glass for its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo. The Biel Crystal agreement covers ultra thin glass tailored for the iPhone Duo form factor, supporting Apple's planned foldable design. Supply chain sources describe Biel Crystal's UTG as a key material input that could influence durability and user experience for the iPhone Duo. headline: Nobody can replace Jensen Huang. What that means for AI
summary: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia after a week of alleged spy ties, reported affairs and a resignation, with about $2 trillion gone from Nvidia's value. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down why he was a one-of-one founder, who might replace him, the rivals circling Nvidia and why a China chip ban could backfire.
